title.narrative: Provide remote and field IM support - 2023
IMSMA Core implemented and deployed in 2 countries

comment.narrative: Iraq: No update Libya: In the second quarter, LIBMAC and GICHD finished processing 95% of the migration and finalized Land Release forms in collabration with operators. During this time, operators submitted their information to LIBMAC using a system called IMSMA Core. In the next quarter, operators will keep providing their reports, and in the fourth quarter, there will be a workshop where LIBMAC will officially launch IMSMA Core and share their findings and recommendations.

Iraq: No update Libya: Moving forward, LIBMAC next step will be to launch all the Land Release forms. In addition to the previously mentioned tasks, the following actions are agreed to be launched in Q2:
Create the missing forms: COMPLETION, QA, QC, and PCIS. Seamlessly integrate the new forms into the existing process. Develop the Handover Certificate workflow and generate the corresponding report.

Libya: as part of the ongoing IMSMA Core implementation, we completed the migration phase from May 1st to June 30th, 2023, which included the transition of various workflows such as Task, EOD, EORE, ACC-VIC, and Land Release. Starting in Q3, operators have begun utilizing the new data collection forms in Survey123 integrated with the updated IMSMA Core system. To further improve the integration and gather valuable operator feedback on their daily use of IMSMA Core in Libya, we are planning to organize an IM stakeholder workshop in Q4 as part of the grant. This workshop aims to enhance the seamless integration of IMSMA Core into their ongoing work. Afghanistan: no feedback. Iraq: no feedback.

title.narrative: Provide remote and field IM support - 2022
IMSMA Core implemented and deployed in 2 countries

comment.narrative: Afghanistan: No update. Libya: Couple of online meeting conducted by the IM team to discuss the IM stakeholder workshop that the GICHD planning to conduct in Q3. The purpose of the workshop is to present the work progress of the IMSMA Core implementation phase for LiBMAC. All NGOs and operators will be invited to attend the workshop in order to share their feedback, suggestions and expctations for the new IM system.

Afghanistan: No update. Libya: IM technical advisory support was provided throughout Q3 to establish mine action modules within the IMSMA Core. Also, the GICHD IM team conducted an Information Management Stakeholder Workshop for the Libyan Mine Action Center (LiBMAC) program in Tunisia from the 16th to the 18th of August. The Workshop was part of the implementation of a new information management system (IMSMA Core) and aimed at supporting the LibMAC and Mine Action NGOs working in Libya (DCA, DDG, HI, the HALO Trust, 3F, etc.) in their transition to the IMSMA Core. The IMSMA Core workshop was attended by 31 participants from the operators and NGOs in Libya with representatives from DCA, DDG, HI, the HALO Trust, 3F, and LPO. During the workshop, the next IMSMA Core implementation steps and phases were outlined. The workshop survey showed an overall high level of participants' satisfaction and relevance to their current functions. Iraq: Have yet to implement plans.

Afghanistan: No update. Libya: The IMSMA Core implementation has been a great opportunity for a full IM review which renewed the cooperation and the dialogue with the IPs. More work should be done by LibMAC to streamline IM and to strengthen its IM department. Iraq: Couple of online meeting conducted by the IM team to discuss the IM workplan with Iraq, starting from signing IPA (Implementing partner agreement ) and plan for IMSMA Core stakeholder workshop that the GICHD planning to conduct in Q2 2023. The purpose of the workshop is to invite DMA and all their implementing partners to present them with the workplan for IMSMA Core implementation and also in order that IPs to share their experience and expected for the new IM system.
No work done in Q1 of 2022. The situation in Afghanistan remains an issue.

comment.narrative: Libya: It was planned to conduct an IM workshop to follow with IMSMA Core implementation in person in Libya. Unfortunately, the COVID-19 restrictions did not allow the workshop to take the place. However, the IM technical support is delivered based on the work plan, the focus of IM advisory support in Q4 was on improving the Polygon/Point collection for land release polygons and developing a workflow for task orders framework in order to enable LiBMAC with tasking mechanism.

The IM technical support started in Q2, after identifying the workplan in agreement with both NMAA, the main provided IM support for Libya were it was Installation brand-new Postgres, developing DE informs, in the Q3 we provided IM support to NMAC to test and pilot the data entry forms via share it with implementing partners to use in the field, and after several meeting with LiBMAC it was decided to conduct an IM workshop in Libya in person by Q4, but we still monitor the situation to follow with COVID rules and restriction.

The IM technical support started in Q2, after identifying the workplan in agreement with both NMAA, the main provided IM support for Libya were; 1. Installed a brand-new Postgres 11 to be the IMSMA Core database. 2. Regarding forms, for the 4 existing forms in the Portal (Accident-Victim, EOD, Land and Education), the support was: - Created new forms (the names start with LibMAC) - Reviewed all the fields and adapted them if necessary (to take into account the migration) - Standardized the 4 forms so that the field names are consistent between forms And the main provided IM support for Afghanistan was preparing the workplan and address the needs along with MARS support for the remote data entry.
